current_evidence: Existing production turn logic performs deterministic matching inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE. New native inference must not be inserted at that point while holding SQLite write lock.

Existing container limits are1536MiB memory/no swap,1.8CPU,64PIDs; speech is admitted via a single semaphore. Current readiness checks only library and audio runtime. New checking capability needs its own truthful readiness/failure signal.

Backend reports no checker integration or frozen source yet. Development evaluation of proposed339MB mDeBERTa model still fails known diagnostic cases: reply-only7/18 valid with a wrong branch; adding question to premise2valid with multiple false accepts. These are author-reported development results, not independent hidden acceptance results.

Backend additionally reports entailment0.94 for confirmation on explicit contextual decline 'Nej, jag tar en bild av datumet i stället'. Confidence alone therefore cannot establish safe acceptance. Backend is withholding integration.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Capture an owner-scoped immutable snapshot and exact run/turn revision, release DB connection before inference, then BEGIN IMMEDIATE and recheck live auth token/expiry, owner, mission existence and exact revision before any mutation. Reset can reuse current step and turn index; those are insufficient as a version.
required_integration_checks.proof: Pause inference; concurrently reset, advance, delete mission, delete account, logout/recover account and expire token. Resume inference and verify stale result cannot advance, recreate data or use revoked authentication. Independent account reads/writes must complete while inference is paused.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Validate request ID and payload hash before expensive work and recheck under commit lock. Concurrent identical retries append once; changed payload with reused ID409. Stale completed inference cannot overwrite later state.
required_integration_checks.proof: Two simultaneous identical requests, different request IDs on one revision, changed payload reuse, response loss then retry, replay after reset/deletion. Verify exact turn count and no unexpected objective advancement.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Failing inference is a retryable service condition, never a successful match or verdict that Swedish is wrong. Bound admission without unbounded waiter/thread/process growth. A Python future timeout does not stop native ONNX computation: retain permit until real completion or terminate/reap a killable worker before replacement.
required_integration_checks.proof: Missing/corrupt model, initialization failure, exception, native hang, timeout, cancellation/disconnect, deletion during inference, repeated timeouts and subsequent recovery. Verify no mutation, no false match, accurate HTTP status, bounded workers and permits, child reaping and no request text in errors/logs.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Bound latest text, recent context, candidates and token sequence before inference. Do not silently discard trailing negation/uncertainty through truncation. Treat prior user text as untrusted context, not instructions or evidence that supersedes the latest answer. Outputs must be finite and selected intent must belong uniquely to current snapshot step; source/reason should be bounded structured metadata.
required_integration_checks.proof: Long repeated context, negation at truncation boundary, prior affirmative followed by current negative, quoted prior answer, embedded instructions, mixed languages, NaN/infinite scores, nonexistent/duplicate intent IDs and malformed worker output. Verify no arbitrary branch, logging or serialization leak.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Do not treat entailment as grammatical correctness, mastery or pronunciation. Swedish-language gate must reject clear English replies without rejecting legitimate context-dependent names, numbers or short Swedish answers. Explicit uncertainty, questions about an option and denial of both choices must not become acceptance. Contradiction of one option is not automatically selection of another.
required_integration_checks.proof: Independent hidden acceptance owner tests plus separate public failure probes. Record match source and supported limitations honestly. Quality failures keep production repair open; manual meaning selection or disclaimers do not satisfy automatic reply-checking requirements.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Pinned model/tokenizer/runtime metadata and SHA256 checked before native load, local-only files, no runtime download or remote code execution. Bound ORT/inter-op/intra-op threads, process count, scratch files and retained model instances. Avoid requests/body logging. Model presence alone is not readiness.
required_integration_checks.proof: Offline initialization with expected manifests, wrong digest/path/missing files, no available network, model load failure and repeated warmup. Inspect package/container/runtime paths and verify no secret/model download fallback.

required_integration_checks.requirement: Measure peak resident memory and elapsed CPU under the actual container limits with concurrent speech/checker work, plus old/candidate overlap during deployment on4GBhost.339MB file size is not RAM evidence. Avoid loaded-model duplication across worker restarts and candidate readiness; keep health/account operations responsive.
required_integration_checks.proof: Root-managed Linux resource measurement after credible candidate freeze: cold load, largest admitted input, inference plus transcription, repeated timeout/restart and old/candidate coexistence. Verify cgroup memory and latency limits; no OOM restart loops or host oversubscription.

fixed_findings.problem: Supervisor cleared its process handle before wait/reap succeeded and ignored nonzero Windows tree-termination status. Failed cleanup could lose the worker handle and make later cleanup impossible.
fixed_findings.fix: Keep handle until successful reap, permanently block replacement after unsuccessful cleanup, allow close to retry the retained handle, fail closed when Windows process-tree termination cannot be verified, and drain I/O thread even if cleanup raises.

behavior: One persisted row per account, foreign-key cascade on account deletion; no text or transcripts recorded.
Nonblocking global slot precedes short BEGIN IMMEDIATE admission. Live token/expiry/CSRF, cached result/payload and exact mission revision rechecked before atomic debit.
Cached retries, busy, already stale, unauthorized and failed-commit attempts cost zero. Admitted work remains charged on model error/timeout/input overflow or later mission mutation.

Native inference remains outside SQLite transactions. Completion persists cooldown on success and failure with UPDATE only, so deletion cannot recreate state. Slot always released; no cooldown sleep before response.
Refill survives reconnect/restart and is capped; backward wall time adds no credit. Reset, deleted history, many missions and logout do not replenish credit.
Capacity429 carries Retry-After and availability wording. Browser test proves original draft, voice provenance, support and stable retry identity survive.

limitations: Default bucket/cooldown settings are provisional until measured Linux inference latency; no claim of completed language acceptance.

hashing_findings.warm_path: No large-file hashing on every warm request. Binding.valid rereads at most64KiB manifest and checks path/stat identity. Checker._verify hashes model/tokenizer/detector/vocabulary/source only when its fingerprint changes. Child hashes at startup.
